sentence_stem: He must have forgotten the meeting,
correct_completion: because he never replied to any messages.
full_sentence: He must have forgotten the meeting, because he never replied to any messages.
acceptable_variants: because he did not answer any of our calls.
since he ignored every reminder we sent.

options.text: so he must have been on time.
options.why_wrong: If he forgot the meeting, he could not have arrived on time, so this contradicts the modal deduction in the stem.

options.why_wrong: 'Although' signals contrast with forgetting, which conflicts with the deduction that he must have forgotten.
Being early makes forgetting less likely, so this does not explain the conclusion that he forgot.

grammar_focus: Modal perfect for a past deduction (must have + past participle)
explanation: 'Must have' plus a past participle expresses a logical conclusion about a past event, and the clause after it gives the evidence. Portuguese speakers often replace this structure with a simple past or a plain modal, because Portuguese uses different verb forms for expressing past certainty.
translation: Ele deve ter esquecido a reunião, porque nunca respondeu a nenhuma mensagem.
